_comment: Add-on archives we ship deliberately on top of a vanilla Zero Hour install. Binaries are never committed; this file pins
name, size and sha256 so scripts/fetch-addons.ps1 can verify whatever it downloads or imports, and so both machines end
up with the identical set (assets.sha256 then proves it). Load order: the engine loads *.big alphabetically and the
FIRST archive to provide a file wins, so the numeric prefix is the priority (310_ beats 340_ beats 400_ beats AudioZH...).
Control Bar Pro bundles GenTool/fullviewport.dat, which upstream's AddonCompat.cpp honours, so no -forcefullviewport is needed.
Confirmed working on our build 2026-10-21 (human-verified in a replay).

Hosting: the archives are assets of release 'addons-v1' in our own private repo ('repo' below); fetch-addons.ps1 downloads them with gh (CI: GH_TOKEN). Add new versions as new release tags and bump 'release' here.

addons.name: Control Bar Pro (2160p)
addons.licence: MIT (TheSuperHackers/GeneralsControlBar); authors EA Games, FAS, xezon
addons._url_note: Original download page per the archive's embedded ControlBarPro.txt: http://gentool.net/download/controlbarpro (file names not yet pinned). Until a URL is pinned, fetch-addons.ps1 -ImportFrom <folder> seeds the cache from a GenPatcher-installed copy.

addons.name: Expanded LAN Lobby Menu
addons._why_disabled: Window-layout mod; upstream has its own LAN lobby fixes and this may conflict. Enable after a test.
